value.name: dicky enters trap room
value.description: Dicky steps into the Trap room where inmates are processed and is noticed by a corrections officer.
evidence: He steps into the Trap, the room in which inmates arrive to be processed, where a guard, Corrections Officer 2, 30s, tall, sits.
CORRECTIONS OFFICER (stands, surprised) Dicky!? What're you doin' here?

value.name: dicky says he must go home
value.description: Dicky insists he needs to go home to reassure someone that everything will be okay and that he does not need to cry.
evidence: DICKY I gotta go home, Harry. I gotta tell Dicky it's gonna be okay, he don't gotta cry.
DICKY - He don't gotta cry no more.

value.name: officer orders dicky back upstairs
value.description: The corrections officer physically stops Dicky and orders him to return upstairs before writing him up.
evidence: CORRECTIONS OFFICER (steps out, puts a hand on DICKY'S SHOULDER) Get back upstairs before I write ya up.
CORRECTIONS OFFICER I don't know what you're talking about, Dicky, but you can't be here. You gotta go back up.

value.name: dicky returns to upper floor
value.description: Dicky turns away from the officer and heads back upstairs as instructed.
evidence: Dicky looks at Corrections Officer 2, turns and heads back.

value.name: dicky walks corridor in distress
value.description: Dicky moves through the second-floor corridor, visibly burdened as sounds of cheering and screaming echo around him.
evidence: CORRIDOR, 2ND FLOOR - B.H.C. - NIGHT. Dicky walking down the dimly lit hall, shadows dancing off walls, distant cheering, screaming echoing...

value.name: dicky enters kitchen and kneels to pray
value.description: Dicky goes into the dark kitchen, drops to his knees on the cement floor, and bows his head in prayer.
evidence: stepping into the dark kitchen... Dicky sinks to his knees onto the hard grey cement floor and bows his head to pray.
